206:t_3:19.en:
$$恭子$$
「It's not just you! Everyone in the Volunteer Club is the same, aren't they!」

206:t_3:20.en:
$$恭子$$
「To you guys, I'm just an outsider!? And I'm supposed to die without knowing anything? I won't accept that!」

206:t_3:22.en:
$$恭子$$
「Why did you keep quiet!? What's going on!?」

206:t_3:23.en:
$$恭子$$
「It started when you guys came to this school! That's when everything started going strange!」

206:t_3:26.en:
$$恭子$$
「$$相良$$... Who on earth are you?」

206:t_3:30.en:
$$クラマ$$
「The men I stationed at key points have been taken out... You did well to get this far all by yourself.」

206:t_3:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not really. A bunch of idiots were lined up waiting for me.」

206:t_3:32.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Your sharp tongue is quite something too, $$相良宗介$$.」

206:t_3:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you were with $$アマルガム$$, $$クラマ$$.」

206:t_3:34.en:
$$クラマ$$
「I'm honored. To think you knew who I was.」

206:t_3:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know you're skilled. And a man like that takes a high school student who knows nothing hostage?」

206:t_3:36.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You're not going to tell me that's cowardly, are you?」

206:t_3:38.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Young lady, if you want to know, I'll tell you. That man is an active killer, the same kind as us. He belongs to a certain mercenary unit.」

206:t_3:41.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You did well, but give it up now. Hand over $$千鳥かなめ$$ and I'll guarantee the safety of that girl and the school.」

206:t_3:42.en:
$$恭子$$
「I knew it. They're after $$カナ$$-chan...」

206:t_3:43.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'm completely on the back foot... Even if I counterattack here, I have no way to take down $$クラマ$$ and his men while protecting $$常磐$$...)

206:t_3:44.en:
$$宗介$$
(If only I had one more ally...)

206:t_3:49.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Tch! So you had an ambush team ready!」

206:t_3:50.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$相良$$! Then, just as I warned, I'll blow up the school building!」

206:t_3:51.en:
$$クラマ$$
「It didn't go off!? Don't tell me the explosives were disarmed!?」

206:t_3:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「I destroyed the detonator! Now you can't blow up the school building!」

206:t_3:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「After I took out your men, I contacted $c and had a certain unit sent over.」

206:t_3:57.en:
$$宗介$$
「Its radio jamming disabled the detonator.」

206:t_3:58.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Damn! So you destroyed the anti-$$ＥＣＳ$$ equipment first, then sent in an AS!」

206:t_3:59.en:
$$クラマ$$
「But how!? $c shouldn't have any forces it could spare for us right now!」

206:t_3:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sure it's hard to believe. That there's an AS that moves without an operator and faithfully carries out our orders as the situation requires...」

206:t_3:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「Well done, $$アル$$! From here on, we go on the attack!」

206:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad...! Just like last time, this is seriously bad!」

206:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm afraid this is hardly the time to be congratulating anyone on becoming an ace pilot, so let's save it for another occasion!」

206:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To think they'd use a $$時空震動弾|lc$$ here...」

206:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business without a break! Even in a $$時空震動|lc$$, I'll give it my all... business, business!」

207:t_000:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're going to burn the whole city indiscriminately!?」

207:t_000:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Damn...! They had already deployed their units at the same time as the warning!」

207:t_000:2.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's because I... refused him that this happened...」

207:t_000:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Right now, think about escaping from here.」

207:t_000:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm scared of myself, having power like that... and of those guys who'll do anything just to kidnap me... And... I'm sorry, but really...」

207:t_000:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even until now, I've been in danger lots of times... And somehow it always worked out...」

207:t_000:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But this time is different... I'm sure... this time... it's hopeless...」

207:t_000:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I can tell... But... I don't understand myself at all...」

207:t_000:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's the same... with you, too...」

207:t_000:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I like you, but I'm scared. I like you so much I can't stand it, but I'm scared...!」

207:t_000:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm panicking so much I don't know what to do...!」

207:t_002:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn it! Those $$アマルガム$$ bastards know we're in tatters from the last fight!」

207:t_002:5.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They mean business! All units, watch out for the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped types!」

207:t_002:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
(We're in trouble here, but it looks like something's going on at $$メリダ島$$ too...)

207:t_002:7.en:
$$マオ$$
($$テッサ$$... I believe you're safe.)

207:t_002:8.en:
$$飯塚$$
「Sorry, $c! We let $$アマルガム$$ break through!」

常磐.evidence: Sousuke's surname-only address for hostage Kyoko Tokiwa (glossary 常盤恭子 = Kyoko Tokiwa; the script writes 磐, the sheet 盤); same token proposed in dlg_2030_03

kept_omissions: 207:t_000:13: あたしには…わかる… - what Kaname understands is not stated (could be 'this time is hopeless' or 'others'); kept as bare 'I can tell...'
207:t_000:8: object of 怖いの is carried over from t_000:6 and completed in t_000:9; kept as 'scared of ... and of ...' across the rows
206:t_3:44: 味方がいれば - 'one more ally' without saying to whom (Sousuke's own thought)
uncertain: 207:t_000:2 あいつ rendered 'him' = Leonard (Kaname refusing Leonard's offer, per 2030_04 t_2:15)
207:t_000:13 / 15 meaning of わかる and そう is ambiguous; kept parallel and vague
206:t_3:19 ボランティア部のみんなも同じ rendered 'the same' (keeping secrets from her)
206:t_3:58 ＥＣＳ written as token $$ＥＣＳ$$ (keyword entry, ECS); ＡＳ as plain 'AS' matching dlg_2030_03
206:t_3:56/59 $c used as a plain noun with no article, as the squad name
206:t_3:32 憎まれ口 = 'sharp tongue'; 206:t_3:38 お嬢さん = 'Young lady'
